_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail on the pattern of the Paper egg (minecraft-paper.yaml): the jar from Leaf's download API (api.leafmc.one, PaperMC's API v2 shape) with its SHA-256 checked, latest meaning the newest Minecraft version with a build in Leaf's default channel, a version or build that does not exist fails the install, the eula flag (the panel asks the owner on the first start, nothing is pre-accepted), Java 25 and 21 images (Leaf starts at 1.21.4; 26.x needs Java 25), Minecraft Java idle sleep, install sandbox defaults and resource hints.
name: Leaf
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Leaf is a performance fork of Paper (with Gale's and other forks' optimisations and async options). Runs Paper, Spigot and Bukkit plugins.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Leaf installation (Octail): the jar from Leaf's download API (api.leafmc.one, PaperMC's API v2 shape),
# its SHA-256 checked. "latest" picks the newest Minecraft version with a build in Leaf's default channel
# (the newest version when none has one) and the newest default build of that version (the newest
# experimental one when there is none). A version or build that doesn't exist fails the install.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -eu

API=https://api.leafmc.one/v2/projects/leaf
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
BUILD="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"

fail() {
	echo "Install failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 "$1"; }

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

PROJECT_JSON=$(get "${API}") || fail "can't reach Leaf's download API (${API})"
# Newest first: Leaf lists its versions in text order ("1.21.11" before "1.21.4", "26.1.2" after both).
ALL=$(echo "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -r '.versions // [] | map(select(type == "string")) |
	sort_by(split(".") | map(tonumber? // 0)) | reverse | .[]')
[ -n "${ALL}" ] || fail "Leaf's API lists no versions"

if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
	VERSION=""
	for v in ${ALL}; do
		DEFAULT=$(get "${API}/versions/${v}/builds" | jq -r '[.builds[] | select(.channel == "default")] | length') || DEFAULT=0
		if [ "${DEFAULT}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
			VERSION="${v}"
			break
		fi
	done
	if [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
		VERSION=$(echo "${ALL}" | head -n 1)
		echo "No Minecraft version has a Leaf build in the default channel yet; using ${VERSION}."
	fi
fi
echo "${ALL}" | grep -qxF "${VERSION}" ||
	fail "Leaf has no Minecraft ${VERSION}. The versions are listed at https://www.leafmc.one/download"

BUILDS=$(get "${API}/versions/${VERSION}/builds") || fail "can't list the Leaf builds of ${VERSION}"
if [ -z "${BUILD}" ] || [ "${BUILD}" = "latest" ]; then
	BUILD=$(echo "${BUILDS}" | jq -r '(.builds // [] | sort_by(.build)) as $all |
		([$all[] | select(.channel == "default")] | last | .build?) // ($all | last | .build?) // empty')
	[ -n "${BUILD}" ] || fail "Leaf has no builds for ${VERSION}"
fi
case "${BUILD}" in
*[!0-9]*) fail "the build number (${BUILD}) must be a number or latest" ;;
esac

INFO=$(echo "${BUILDS}" | jq -c --arg b "${BUILD}" '.builds[] | select((.build | tostring) == $b)') || INFO=""
[ -n "${INFO}" ] || fail "Leaf has no build ${BUILD} for ${VERSION}"
NAME=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.downloads.primary.name // empty')
SHA256=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.downloads.primary.sha256 // empty' | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')
CHANNEL=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.channel // empty')
echo "${NAME}" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9._+-]+\.jar$' || fail "Leaf's API named no jar for build ${BUILD} of ${VERSION}"
echo "${SHA256}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' || fail "Leaf's API gave no SHA-256 for build ${BUILD} of ${VERSION}"
if [ "${CHANNEL}" != "default" ]; then
	echo "Note: Leaf ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} is marked ${CHANNEL}, not default (stable)."
fi

echo "Installing Leaf ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} as ${JAR}"
rm -f "${JAR}.download"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 -o "${JAR}.download" "${API}/versions/${VERSION}/builds/${BUILD}/downloads/${NAME}" ||
	fail "the download of Leaf ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} failed"
GOT=$(sha256sum "${JAR}.download" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if [ "${GOT}" != "${SHA256}" ]; then
	rm -f "${JAR}.download"
	fail "SHA-256 mismatch for Leaf ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} (expected ${SHA256}, got ${GOT})"
fi
if [ -f "${JAR}" ]; then
	mv -f "${JAR}" "${JAR}.old"
fi
mv "${JAR}.download" "${JAR}"

echo "Leaf ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} installed (SHA-256 checked)."
echo "Accepting the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA) is the server owner's decision: the panel asks on the first start."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description:
The Minecraft version to install, such as 1.21.11, or latest for the newest version with a build in Leaf's default (stable) channel. A version Leaf has no build for fails the install.

The Startup image must fit it: Java 25 for 26.x, Java 21 or 25 for 1.21.x.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jar file.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: The Leaf build to install, or latest for the newest default-channel build of that Minecraft version (the newest experimental one when it has none).
